data.name: farmers walk
instructions: Step:1 Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your sides.
Step:2 Keep your spine in a comfortable neutral position and your shoulders back.
Step:3 Stand tall with the load secure and the shoulders level.
Step:4 Walk at a controlled pace, keeping your shoulders level and your steps even.
Step:5 Keep steps even and avoid leaning away from the load.
Step:6 Stop before posture breaks down, set the load down safely, and reset for the next walk.
